headline: Peruvian sol closes at S/3.47 against US dollar amid rising demand and copper drop
summary: The US dollar closed at S/3.470 in the Peruvian interbank market, rising from S/3.463 due to falling copper prices and higher foreign currency demand.
why: Exchange rate fluctuations in emerging market commodity exporters directly reflect shifts in terms of trade and local liquidity.

impacts.name: US Dollar / Peruvian Sol
impacts.why: Increased foreign exchange demand and lower copper export revenues drive up the exchange rate.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
